scope: Independent root read of four TV lifecycle sources and actual 42-state JVM replay
checks: Explicit same-URL source change, same quality and same decoder rebuild the engine instead of retaining a possibly stalled prepared instance
Release precedes queue assignment; commit samples matching actual episode position/play intent; no source scoring or registry changes
Checkpoint preserves valid time/duration on transient nonpositive reads; explicit seek-to-zero resets intent before reads
In-session near-tail/source-cut carry clamps to new duration; history-completion policy remains separate
Native callbacks require unreleased engine identity; Activity callbacks additionally require current playback generation
Media3 seek receipt requires own target acknowledgement and READY/position agreement; arbitrary events cannot acknowledge pending seeks
Reload preserves fixed speed and pause intent; live seek/clock/auto restrictions remain
No periodic restarts; only explicit reload and bounded existing source selection
